baselineNotes: A broader pre-existing address-format suite was sampled and reported two unrelated baseline failures outside CV: a West Africa note expectation and a VC source registration. They were excluded from the CV package gate and not modified.
The npm launcher could not inherit the explicit Node path on this host. The exact package targets were executed directly with the bundled Node, local tsx and local tsc.
The in-app Browser and local image viewer failed at Windows helper boundaries; deterministic Chromium evidence is recorded without claiming manual visual inspection.
The dependency tree was reused through an isolated-worktree junction; no package was installed or downloaded.

Eight official reference bodies and browser artifacts were retained only in a temporary directory for verification and will be removed after publication; their digests and semantic receipts are committed, not the raw bodies.
